Held equipment MUST be: two short curved sabers, one in each hand. Coil then make a strong crossing double cut, left then right blade, compact crossed slash streaks; guard crosses BOTH blades. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: athletic adult brown-skinned desert woman with long dark braid, narrow ivory headband, turquoise jacket and brass lamellar shoulder armor, crimson sash, loose ivory trousers and leather riding boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency. 6 columns, 6 rows, 36 poses.
